description: The 34 active oil and gas leases in the Pacific OCS (off California), from BOEM's Pacific Region map service (POC_Layers layer 7). `LEASE_STATUS_CD` is BOEM's own code (UNIT = committed to a unit, PROD = producing, RENACV is kept as served); `status` is `active` for all of them because the layer lists active leases only. Lease numbers are served as P00202 and published in BOEM's formal form `OCS-P 0202`. Built by catalog/build_erin_layers.py from 1 source layer(s).

links.title: U.S. federal government work (BOEM / BSEE), public domain; the service carries no separate terms.
